# powerdns_axfr_retrieve (Action)

Triggers a zone transfer from the zone's primary.

`Slave` zones only. Any other kind answers 422 naming the reason, which this reports rather than the status code.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The zone to act on.
